integrity: The proof gives an infinite structural argument; the verifier independently simulates the forcing process. The directly relevant prior complete-multipartite scalar theorem is explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 10 corroborates but does not prove the infinite theorem.
The known scalar formula for the positive semidefinite zero forcing number is prior work and is not claimed as new.
title: Positive semidefinite zero forcing polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
